title: Old Steel Axe
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: All Steel Axes have been replaced by the Tall Steel Axe.

"Forged with 100% pure steel, this will do some serious damage"

Description

Steel Axe (Usually called Short Steel Axe) was once an axe sold at The Oak Depot. It's a weaker and smaller version of the Tall Steel Axe, and was sold next to it. The reason why it was removed, is probably due to the fact that there was too small of a difference between the two.

Appearance

Steel Axe is a small hatchet made out of wood and steel. It's headpiece is dark gray in color and uses the default legacy metal texture. Handle, like any other axe, is made out of dark brown wood with default legacy wood material applied to it. At the bottom of it there is a small hole.

Trivia

  • Originally it was named Steel Axe, but after v1.52.0 Tall Steel Axe was renamed to "Steel Axe"
